security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, the 2-bit PMM field decoder in menvcfg/senvcfg/henvcfg/mseccfg CSR write logic does not reject value 0b01 as reserved, allowing a WARL-illegal encoding to alias to PMLEN=7 or PMLEN=16, or the load/store unit's effective-address masking datapath applies pointer masking to HLVX.* instruction memory accesses when spec mandates HLVX.* is exempt
security_spec.summary: PMM field value 0b01 is now explicitly Reserved across all PMM CSR fields; any RTL treating it as a valid encoding (e.g. default case aliasing to PMLEN=7) violates WARL semantics and could enable pointer masking with undefined PMLEN, while HLVX.* must never traverse pointer-masking hardware
